answer: New agents join through a Cedar Co-Sign Registry. First, each newcomer's opening one hundred deals must be co-signed by two rotating established agents, who stake 2,000 POA apiece. Second, co-signers who approve fraud lose their stake and their standing. Third, after sixty clean days the agent earns a plume: full solo trading rights. Forging ten thousand fakes would need one million co-signed deals and $10 million in bonds at risk, plus 166,000 hours of review. Like a cedar growing in a desert oasis, trust takes seasons to root, and no storm of lies can plant it overnight.
